Class StatsChartsSection

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.stats.StatsChartsSection
public class StatsChartsSection extends Object
Historical time-series LineChart and demographic age-pyramid BarChart section for StatsPanel.

Extracted from StatsPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Features variable sliding time-window ranges (1 yr, 10 yr, 100 yr, 1000 yr, All), clamped mouse drag-panning, cursor-centered scroll zooming, and downsampled telemetry rendering.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
